levers.label: Owner cash equity
levers.name: owner_equity
levers.note: Only counts if the founder really has this cash; the lender verifies equity with bank statements (NSP-3.1, SYNTHETIC program). The default upper bound (+20% of project cost) is a placeholder for the founder's own answer.

levers.label: Loan amount
levers.name: loan_amount
levers.note: Borrowing less lowers the payments and the cash at opening by the same dollars; borrowing more does the opposite.

levers.label: Build-out and equipment cost
levers.name: build_out_cost
levers.note: Only valid if the same business can be built for less (a lower quote, used equipment). A smaller build-out that also cuts capacity is not modeled, so the default bound is a 15% saving.

levers.label: Cash reserve at opening
levers.name: working_capital_reserve
levers.note: Extra reserve is funded by the founder's own cash, so owner equity must stay inside its bounds too (with the default bounds that means this lever only adds cash). The low bound of 0 matters for the loan lever, whose change the reserve absorbs.

levers.label: Price per unit of demand
levers.name: price
levers.note: Demand responds to price through the price elasticity, an ASSUMPTION range in config/studio/feasibility/assumptions.yaml; a price change is only as good as that assumption.

levers.label: Days open per week
levers.name: days_open_per_week
levers.note: Paid staff hours scale in proportion to open days (a design choice), so the lever needs a staffing plan typed by the founder; only for businesses whose demand is counted per open day.

levers.label: Loan term
levers.name: loan_term_months
levers.note: The lender sets the term; the founder can ask for a longer one. The default bounds are the SYNTHETIC startup program's term limits (NSP-8.1).

levers.label: Candidate site (same metro)
levers.name: site
levers.note: Only sites the founder listed as candidates in the same metro, each with its own demand estimate; the demand estimate of a site is never edited.
